messages:
Diego R.: hey team, excited to be here! quick checklist Qs: who do I ping for VPN/VPC access, a dedicated inference queue account, and repo write perms? trying to avoid chasing people all day :sweat_smile:
Maya (DevEx): welcome Diego! :tada: short map — VPN/VPC: Jordan - Infra, dedicated inference creds: eng-platform (cc Aria for ML-specifics), repo perms: People Ops (Taylor). if you'd like i can open the tickets for you.
Jordan - Infra: hi Diego — for VPC/VPN send this as the ticket body:
``nresource: vpn or vpc access
project: <team-project>
justification: <why>
ssh_pubkey: <ssh-rsa AAAA...>
required_by: <date>
egress: yes/no
``nWe typically handle within 24h for dev access. tag @Maya if you want help.
Taylor (People Ops): repo write perms: include your manager and list CI bots needing access. team-level write is default; cross-team exceptions take 48h. I'll watch for your request.
Aria (Eng-ML): for the inference queue, include workload basics (qps, avg seq len, batch), and whether you need persistent cache. if it's for prod-facing infra we need eng-sre signoff.
Lina (Security): private model pulls or customer data flows require a security review + data flow diagram. typical turnaround 48-72h. Flag `security-review` in the ticket to speed it up.
Simon SRE: escalation lanes: owner -> team lead (2h) -> eng-oncall (4h) -> head infra (8h) for blocked access. For production incidents always page @eng-oncall first.
welcome-bot: Diego R. added to #new-hires, wiki access granted, and onboarding checklist assigned to Maya (DevEx).
Diego R.: brilliant, thank you all. i'll open the three tickets now with those templates and tag the owners. pinging @Maya if you can shepherd the infra ticket :pray:
